descriptions.w3d_d30e_read_tga_801da28c: Reads a TGA image from a stream into a new generic image (Mark Kilgard's public gliReadTGA, with stream reads and seeks through virtual slots 3 and 5): checks footer and header, decodes the image type, validates channel sizes, reads the optional color map with BGR to RGB swap, reads each row through the plain or run-length reader, reverses rows when needed, and fills the 36-byte result. Errors format into the buffer at 0x8045d818 and return null.
